_doc: Look of the blast effects (native/src/render/effects). Style values, matched by eye to the photos of the reference game (ports/demolition/photos-4.0.md), not physics: the physics of the blow (what it destroys, how far) is data/catalog/blast.json. Puff kinds are those of render/shaders/puffs.gdshader. A burst is count puffs of a kind over spread (metres plus a share of the fireball radius) at a height, each of size_m plus a share of the radius and a life in seconds; kind -1 is the soil's dust (earth dust over earth, concrete dust elsewhere). The fireball radius is the scar's (data/catalog/tuning.json strike.scar_radius_m + scar_radius_per_force x force): one law for what is drawn and what is struck. The shock ring races out to reach_r times the fireball radius (the reference game's render/blast.ts ringReach); the damage reach comes from the blast model.

shapes._doc: The sizes, counts, speeds and shares every effects file plays with, one block per file (render/effects/effect_shapes.h). Metres, seconds and metres a second unless the name says otherwise: _share and _k shares, a whole number a count. The values are the source game's, as its files held them, and the sources the files' comments gave (B4 of log/review.md re-sources them).

effect_blast._doc: The events of a blow (effect_blast.cpp): a building down's ruin is centred within ruin_match_m of the event; sparks from a building hit spark_count_per_kpa a kilopascal it felt (at most hit_spark_max, hit_spark_size and hit_spark_life); its dust from hit_dust_min plus hit_dust_per_kpa, hit_spread_m wide, hit_size_m and hit_life_s, rising hit_lift_m; shrapnel starts shell_lift_m over the ground, shell_out_share out, flattened shell_flat_min plus shell_flat_span; a body down throws paper from down_paper_height_m and smoke down_smoke_size_scale of the dust's size; a collapse's dust rises collapse_dust_high_m; soot's size jitters soot_size_jitter.

crater_slabs._doc: The broken ground round a crater (effect_blast.cpp crater_slabs; the reference game's render/blast.ts crater), every distance a share of the crater's decal radius R (marks.h: CRATER_SCALE times the hole's radius) unless named in metres. The slab's outline: outline_corners corners at outline_r plus outline_wave times sin(k outline_wave_k + outline_wave_phase), every outline_notch_every-th one pulled in outline_notch, the rest pushed out outline_bulge; its faces bevelled bevel_thick deep and bevel_size wide (shares of the unit slab). The rim: rim_base plus rim_per_m a metre of R slabs, evenly round the hole jittered rim_jitter_rad, at rim_r_min plus rim_r_span of R, rim_size_min_m plus rim_size_span_m across (rim_earth_scale of it in earth), rim_thick_hard_m or rim_thick_earth_m thick, deep rim_depth_min plus rim_depth_span of their width, tipped rim_tilt_min plus rim_tilt_span rad about the line across the way out, nudged rim_out_ms out and rim_up_ms up from rim_lift_m over the ground; every rim_concrete_every-th of paving is concrete. The plates: plates_base plus plates_per_m a metre of R (at most plates_most; none when plates_crowd lie already within plates_crowd_r of R), at plate_r_min plus plate_r_span times a square-root draw of R, plate_w_min_m plus plate_w_span_m wide times min(plate_scale_most, plate_scale_min plus plate_scale_per_m a metre of R), deep plate_d_min plus plate_d_span of the width, plate_thick_hard_m or plate_thick_earth_m thick, tipped plate_tilt_min plus plate_tilt_span rad and turned at random about the vertical, lifted plate_lift_share of their width; of paving, concrete with chance plate_concrete_chance, else asphalt; each dirtied toward dirt_tint (sRGB) by dirt_min plus dirt_span and shaded shade_min plus shade_span; every clod_every-th has a clod of earth clod_min_m plus clod_span_m across and clod_h_m high, clod_lift_m over the ground. The plates and clods are laid for good, never moved.

gore._doc: The guts and bones of an opened body (gore.cpp; the reference game's render/gore.ts and ragdoll.ts openBelly and boneOut, its numbers). A gut: links Verlet points seg_min_m plus seg_span_m apart, radius_min_m plus radius_span_m round, coiled out of the wound coil_m wide, coil_turn rad a link, dropping coil_drop of a link each; held to the belly (and, with chance pelvis_chance, a second to the pelvis thrown pelvis_kick of the kick) until, with chance hold_chance, it tears loose after hold_min_s plus hold_span_s; each step its speed kept damp, iterations passes of its links, on the ground ground_keep of its speed along it; still once moving under still_m a step for still_s, at most step_most_s a frame and kicked over step_s. At most most_segments links and most_bones bones. A bone out of a stump: bone_r_m round, bone_len_m out (bone_head_len_m from the neck), with chance bone_chance, its cuff of raw flesh cuff_r_m round and cuff_len_m long. A body is opened by a bullet's trunk wounds (kicked shot_kick_ms), a blast tearing it apart with chance torn_open_chance and killing it with dead_open_chance (kicked torn_kick_ms). Tints sRGB: gut_tints three of three channels, bone_tint, cuff_tint.

wires._doc: The wires torn off felled poles (wires.cpp; the reference game's blast.ts wire and stepRope, its numbers and its utilities.ts pole): one rope a primary wire of each span left with one pole standing, points Verlet points seg apart at slack of the span's share, pinned at the standing pole's arm (arm_drop_m under its top, primary_m along the arm across the span) and loose at the felled pole fall_share up it, thrown kick_ms away from the blast (at least least of it, falling off to far_share fireball radii); at most most ropes, the oldest going. A step keeps damp of its speed, iterations passes of its links, on the ground ground_lift_m over it keeping ground_keep of its speed along it; stepped every step_s. Its loose end, live for sparks_min_s plus sparks_span_s, sparks spark_hz a second within spark_near_m of the ground (spark_count sparks spark_spread_m wide, spark_size_m, spark_life_s); a rope moves for life_s. Drawn thick_m thick, tint sRGB.

effect_bodies._doc: The people a blow or a bullet struck (effect_bodies.cpp). An adult standing (NASA-STD-3000 vol. 1 table 3.3.1, the 50th percentile mean of both sexes, rounded to the box that holds the part): the middle of the skull, trunk, arms and legs over the ground (skull_centre_m, trunk_centre_m, arm_centre_m, leg_centre_m), the limbs' side offsets (arm_side_m, leg_side_m), the skull's, sleeves' and legs' boxes. A body thrown topples at topple_ms, its limbs scatter at limb_scatter_ms, a torn one pushed torn_push; walls within walls_reach_m stop it; under no_push_below_m nothing is pushed; a body lies at least least_life_s. A tracer reaches tracer_reach_m; a wound sprays wound_spray puffs of wound_size_m for wound_life_s over wound_spread_m; a car's bodywork hit throws spark_count sparks (spark_spread_m, spark_size_m, spark_life_s) and shards shards (shard_size_m, shard_thick_m, at shard_speed_ms for shard_life_s).

effect_things._doc: What a blow reaches (effect_things.cpp), the pieces' own sizes: a mast, a post, a hydrant, a bench (its slat bench_slat_share of its height), a bin, a trunk (top and stump shares, crown height crown_height_k) and its leaves (crown_leaves of them) and splinters (splinters, splinter_*); thrown at throw_speed, lifted throw_lift, scattered throw_scatter (slower when heavy thrown_slow, trees thrown_tree); sparks (spark_puffs, spark_spread, spark_size, spark_life). Vehicles: a wreck wreck_l by wreck_w by wreck_h, a car burns car_burn_s (a moped moped_burn_s, a trunk trunk_burn_s) and is thrown car_throw_speed, lifting wreck_lift; tyres roll_r wide roll_w; fire puffs (fire_puffs_car, fire_puffs_bike, fire_spread_car, fire_spread_bike, fire_size, fire_life). People killed: blood puffs (blood_puffs, blood_spread_m, blood_size_m, blood_life_s); organs organs_min plus organs_span of organ_min_m plus organ_span_m, thrown organ_speed, flattened organ_flat_min, thin organ_thin plus organ_thin_span, round organ_round; the chest rises chest_rise_m; blood scattered scatter_blood_m; pools pool_min plus pool_span (torn bodies pool_torn, torn_pools of them); drips drip_scatter_m apart, drip_min_m plus drip_span_m. A pole snapped leaves a stump snap_min plus snap_span of its height and throws the top; its cross-arm arm_l_m by arm_t_m and its lamp lamp_l_m by lamp_h_m by lamp_w_m, lamp_reach_m out, are knocked off (the reference game's playEffects.ts explode and utilities.ts). What a blast throws is pushed less with the distance, to fall_least at fall_far_share fireball radii; a tree of the woods felled leaves a charred stump cut_min plus cut_span of its height, its crown at crown_share of it. A shrub falls as a tree shrub_h tall; any other piece of street furniture (a drain, a postbox, a sign) bursts into bits pieces bit_l_min plus bit_l_span long, bit_h_min plus bit_h_span high and bit_w_min plus bit_w_span wide, from bit_lift_m up (the reference game's playEffects.ts explode, its other items).

effect_ruins._doc: What a building brought down leaves (effect_ruins.cpp): heap pieces over the lot, pieces_per_m2 of its area plus pieces_per_storey a storey (storeys_per_m of its height), between heap_fewest and heap_most, drawn from the record's seed in seed_span; slabs at least slab_min_m, pieces piece_span_m across flattened piece_flat_min plus piece_flat_span; the heap heap_height_k of the building's height between heap_min_m and heap_max_m; falling pieces start fall_out_m out and fall_down_m down.

ruin_pieces._doc: A building's own walls falling as pieces (ruin_pieces.cpp): at most most_falls ruins drawn as pieces at once (the rest of a razed block falls as plain heaps), a piece ending at most box_spread of the building's height from it, stepped at most steps_most times a frame; dust each dust_a_frame frames, dust_count puffs with chance dust_chance, dust_size_m for dust_life_s over dust_spread of a piece; a landing's dust within land_radius_m with chance land_chance, land_life_s over land_spread_m; a lot padded lot_pad_m. (A person going down raises effects.json down.dust_*.)

ruin_sim._doc: The fall of a building's pieces (ruin_sim.cpp): what starts within resting_m of the ground rests on it (bonded to the world); a piece is thrown throw_base_ms plus throw_per_force_ms a unit of force, at least throw_share_least of it, what falls from the break running at break_power_ms falls rather than flies; throws from throw_least spanning throw_span, upwards throw_up, turned within turn_range, spinning spin_base plus spin_per_power; the break runs a bond in hop_s (hop_least plus hop_span of it); support is checked every support_every_s; pieces rest at mound_fill of a mound's height (its shader's slumps average under it); a fall lasts at most longest_fall_s and lands at land_speed_ms; the pile map's cells are pile_cell_m over pile_over of the lot's reach, at most pile_most_side a side; a settle takes at most settle_most_steps steps.

mounds._doc: The rubble mounds (mounds.cpp): a hill of relief_cells cells a side, its bell flat to bell_power and falling away by bell_shoulder, noise moving lump_share of its height over three scales (lump_wide, lump_mid, lump_fine) weighed coarse_share, mid_share and fine_share.

effect_world._doc: The effects' owner (effect_world.cpp): a stalled frame never advances the effects by more than max_frame_s; mark_slots craters, soot, blood and rings and mound_slots mounds drawn at once; a burning building flames from roof_flame_base_m over its ground up to roof_flame_span_m higher, flame_span_share of it at most roof_flame_cap_m; a shake never under shake_floor; the flash damped flash_damp, its light falling off light_atten; a hydrant's geyser lifts geyser_lift_m, its jet jet_spread_m wide for jet_life_s.

puffs._doc: The puff pool (puffs.cpp): each puff's size varies from size_min by size_span and its life from life_low by life_span; a burst's spread is flattened to spread_flatten upwards and the puffs sit spread_floor of it under and over its height.

debris._doc: The thrown pieces (debris.cpp): each spins up to random_spin_range rad/s either way and its shade varies from tint_min by tint_span; a burning piece flames flame_over_m and smokes smoke_over_m over itself (smoke_spread_m wide), the flame's size following the piece's to flame_follow_share; a model keeps wrecks_kept wrecks, the oldest going past it (the source game's blast.ts).
